record.question: The baud rate when using the binary transmission is :
options: Always equal to the bit rate
Equal to twice the BW of an ideal channel
Not equal to the signalling rate
Equal to one half of the BW of ideal channel
record.explanation: For binary transmission each symbol carries one bit, so the baud (signalling) rate equals the bit rate.
